title: Car Rental Rate Classes: How an Approved Refund Settles
content:
An approved refund settles to the original form of payment and in no other form, because a car rental carries no credit of its own. A payout line is raised only while the rental record stands at cancelled, no show or returned. The settlement takes the rate class's processing time, counted in business days from the day the refund was approved, excluding weekends and public holidays in the renter's country of residence. Each payout is raised against the original ledger line it reverses, so a rental with several lines settles as several payouts and never as one lump sum. A payout may never exceed the amount that original line actually collected, and the sum of a rental's payouts may never exceed its ledger total. Where the supplier declines the refund the rental is closed with no payout and the renter is told which supplier reference declined it.

**The form of the settlement.** There is one form and one only: the original form of payment. A rental on the Car Rental Rate Classes carries no credit of its own, so no settlement is ever made as credit.

**When a payout may be raised.** The rental record must stand at cancelled, at no show or at returned, and the rental record is the authority for that, read before the payout is raised against the rental it belongs to. A rental standing at booked, confirmed, picked up or closed is not open for a payout.

**The two ceilings.**

| Ceiling | What it limits |
|---|---|
| The original line | A payout may never exceed the amount that original line actually collected |
| The rental's ledger | The sum of a rental's payouts may never exceed its ledger total |

**Counting the processing time on hypothetical dates.** The clock starts on the day the refund was approved and runs in business days, with weekends and public holidays in the renter's country of residence left out of the count. On a class publishing 10 business days, an approval on a Monday with no public holiday intervening settles on the Monday a fortnight later, since the two intervening weekends are not counted. On a class publishing 0 business days no waiting period arises at all.

**Line by line.** A rental that collected money on several ledger lines settles as several payouts, each raised against the line it reverses. Where the supplier declines the refund, the rental is closed with no payout at all, and the renter is told which supplier reference declined it.
